relationships.subject: high-fat diet
relationships.evidence_quote: The 42% and 60% diet both induced labelled PGP9.5 IENFD reductions

key_findings: Total PGP9.5 intraepidermal nerve fibres declined in STZ type 1 and high-fat-diet models, while CGRP-positive IENF density did not differ from controls.
Langerhans cells rose in STZ skin and correlated negatively with IENFD but not in diet models.
